name: openblas
description: OpenBLAS is an optimized BLAS library based on GotoBLAS2 1.13 BSD version.
Build with clang-cl on Windows MSVC triplets, enabling the optimized kernels.
MSVC can only build the generic C kernels. On x64 this also enables runtime CPU detection (DYNAMIC_ARCH).

dynamic-arch.description: Support for multiple targets in a single library

description: Use simple thread safety for level3 functions
Alternative to serialization of concurrent access to parallelized level3 functions.
